static_traits.name: Song Kai
static_traits.educational_background: Studying radiology at a local university
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues are somewhat tense due to self-blame; has a few friends to talk to, but finds it hard to discuss feelings of guilt and self-blame with them
static_traits.medical_history: Denying past psychotherapy / counseling experience; no significant physical illness; no similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, able to describe inner experience; marked Self-blame and guilt, negative emotional tone; cooperative and willing to try exploration and small experiments; speech rate and volume Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Because I missed answering an important call for my supervisor, I feel I ruined the whole day, which led to strong guilt and self-blame.
basic_info.core_demands: Overwhelming guilt and self-blame affect daily life and work performance, therefore seeks counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not competent at this Work / I am a failure
Making a mistake equals total failure and will disappoint everyone

special_situations.event: While working reception at the Doctor's office, missed an important call from the boss
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am Making a mistake at work, it means I am incompetent and disappoint everyone
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly apologizing and trying to make amends, repeatedly replaying and blaming oneself to 'prevent recurrence'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed everything up, the whole day is ruined

special_situations.event: On the same day, still completed part of the work tasks (helping patients, finishing several items), but attention was always occupied by the mistake
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless performance is perfect, no achievement counts
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores the parts done well, keeps staring at mistakes to drive oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: What was done well is meaningless, because I made a mistake

special_situations.event: Thinking about how colleagues or the boss will view this mistake in the future
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make one mistake, others will always remember it and negate me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication with friends, maintains self-criticism to show 'responsibility'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They surely no longer trust me; this Work may not be kept

special_situations.event: Making any small mistake at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Making one mistake means I am simply not suited for this Work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive effort and overtime; self-blame to avoid erring again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not suited for this job

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and trusted, to prove oneself competent and reliable
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being negated, blamed, or Being rejected for one mistake, thus losing others' trust and position
defense_goal: Avoids mistakes and maintains control and a sense of safety through self-reproach and pursuit of perfection

object_relations.self_representation: A disappointing failure, someone needing constant self-monitoring
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh evaluators / others easily disappointed and negating me (e.g. boss, colleagues)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes behavioral experiments and trying new methods
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing trying is meaningless, the mistake cannot be undone ('I have already messed up')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a negative, cautious tone, stressing 'this may be useless' and 'little meaning', holding reservations about change.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When one's mistakes are pointed out or recalled at work
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will be disappointed or negate me because of this; relationships and position threatened
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Reinforcing self-blaming language ('It is all my fault'), downplaying external factors, in a Repressed tone, avoiding expressing dissatisfaction.

manifestations: Having a few friends to talk to, but unwilling to confide Guilt and self-blame to them, avoiding 'troubling others'
outcomes: Impaired attention, decreased learning and daily functioning
Increased sense of Strained and distant interpersonal relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial ('I am not suited for this job')
Unwilling to discuss guilt with friends to avoid 'troubling others'
Highly cautious and reserved about new attempts during sessions

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Treating 'must be without error / perfect' as self-standards
Believes the rule that 'strong guilt is needed to maintain performance'

exception_events.target_problem: When making a mistake at work, the client usually ruminates persistently and blames themselves intensely, believing 'the whole day is ruined', and finds it hard to focus on completing tasks.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On the day of the missed call, although strongly self-blaming, he still helped other patients and completed some tasks, showing that the narrative of 'the whole day was ruined' is not entirely true.
exception_events.reason: Cues: in the work situation there were still clear job tasks to handle, and the client has a sense of responsibility and basic ability, which enabled them to still complete part of the work under strong emotions.

positive_force: Has basic job competence and a sense of responsibility, can still complete some tasks after making mistakes
Willing to try new perspectives and small experiments, with Reflection capacity
Has taken remedial actions (apologizing, making amends), showing motivation to cope with the problem
Has some social support (a few friends to talk with)
negative_force: Marked cognitive distortions of catastrophizing and all-or-nothing (overgeneralization, mental filtering, negating the positive)
Driven by intense self-reproach and shame/guilt
Avoiding seeking help from others, worrying about burdening them, leading to insufficient support
Repeated rumination impairs attention and work / study performance

target_behavior.behavior: After making mistakes, repeatedly ruminates with strong guilt and self-blame
antecedent: Mistakes occur at work (such as missing an important call)
Recalling it afterward and associating the mistake with the scene
target_behavior.core_reason: Formed catastrophic all-or-nothing beliefs of 'mistake = failure / not trusted / disappointing everyone', maintaining control and avoiding recurrence through self-blame
target_behavior.function: Avoiding inner Anxiety and using self-blame as self-motivation (trying to prevent errors through harshness)
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased attention, impaired Work and Learning performance, Interpersonal tension, Anxiety and guilt maintained or even worsened

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding confiding in friends and seeking support
antecedent: When Strong guilt / Self-blame emotions arise
Worrying about troubling others or being judged
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjected strict rules (should bear it alone, cannot trouble others) and prediction of others' negative evaluation
target_behavior.function: Avoiding shame / exposure and the discomfort of being evaluated in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient use of support system, sense of Loneliness and Accumulated stress, Negative emotions persisting
